scripts.deploy: npm run validate && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:d1: npm run validate && npm run build:d1 && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.d1.jsonc && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --local --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:list:remote: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
